entries.54c1bed93ff889ec: The consolidated subsidiary PT. KANEFUSA INDONESIA produces industrial machine blades, mainly receiving supplies of raw materials and semi-finished products from the company, and sells them mainly in Southeast Asia, centered on Indonesia and Malaysia, to the company and its affiliates. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,378 million.
entries.643008a9b4fa35ae: The consolidated subsidiary KANEFUSA EUROPE B.V. purchases industrial machine blades and related products and sells them in Europe. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,288 million.
entries.7b424e9e00c05d2f: The consolidated subsidiary KANEFUSA USA, INC. purchases industrial machine blades and related products, mainly sells them in North America, and provides re-sharpening services. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,462 million.
entries.912ad6725a7fcd6c: The consolidated subsidiary Kunshan Kanefusa Advanced Cutting Tools Co., Ltd. produces industrial machine blades, mainly receiving supplies of raw materials and semi-finished products from the company, and sells them in China, to the company and its affiliates. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥933 million.
entries.a22132d723369053: The consolidated subsidiary KANEFUSA DO BRASIL LTDA. purchases industrial machine blades and related products, sells them in South America and provides re-sharpening services. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥785 million.
entries.cac6ca3f550294ee: The consolidated subsidiary KANEFUSA VIETNAM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. receives supplies of raw materials and semi-finished products from the company to produce industrial machine blades and sells them to the company, and KANEFUSA VIETNAM CO., LTD. sells them within Vietnam and provides re-sharpening services. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥153 million.
entries.db02724908fdb107: The company produces industrial machine blades and related products and sells them in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,777 million.
entries.ffc4d159a4aaa8bc: KANEFUSA CORPORATION is a comprehensive blade manufacturer that makes and sells industrial machine blades.
